source.title: tr4ker as a second fully supported Tracker (map)
source.body:
tr4ker.net becomes TorrentLinker's second fully supported **Tracker**, beside c411. Today tr4ker can only be a search-only Indexer for Cross-seed. This map tracks the whole integration. It was decided in a grilling session on 2026-11-23.

## Decisions so far

The ADRs land with the first PR as `docs/adr/0025` to `0027`, plus an amendment to ADR-0023 and glossary updates in `CONTEXT.md`.

- **Tracker** is a new glossary term: a site with an account, a native API, Upload rules and an economy. Each Tracker owns one Indexer. c411 and tr4ker are Trackers. Prowlarr, Jackett and hand-added Indexers stay search-only.
- Settings > Connection gets tabs: c411 | tr4ker | Indexers. An existing tr4ker Indexer, recognised by host, is adopted in place and keeps its key and Cross-seed history.
- Discovery screens (Search, Media, Catalogue, Reseed, Cross-seed) merge both Trackers with a badge on each row and no dedupe, because the info-hashes differ (`info.source` is `C411` or `TR4KER`). Profile, Upload and Plans have a Tracker picker.
- Auto-pick (Media, Requests, RSS) uses ReleaseScore, then the Tracker order in Settings (c411 first). The other Tracker follows through automatic Cross-seed (ADR-0024).
- Auth: the API key covers Torznab, Cross-seed and downloads, the passkey covers RSS and announce, and the companion extension covers native JSON (session cookies stay in the browser). `/api/me` returns the key and passkey: filter it, and never call `/api/me/api-key`, which regenerates the key.
- Everything tracker-specific gets a Tracker namespace. Existing rows migrate as c411.
- Catalogue: crawl `/api/torznab/all` by offset. It includes torrents without seeders. The native listing caps its total at 1001, and filtered native queries returned HTTP 500.
- Credits: show balance, ratio and shop now, log payouts, and show a learned estimate labelled as such. tr4ker publishes no formula.
- Upload: multi-target Local Drafts with one approval and a send state per target. c411 still gets a remote Draft. tr4ker runs a preflight, then publishes directly.
- Community: comments, thanks, topic chat and reports. Trust votes and class chat show as unavailable on tr4ker. tr4ker-only extras are included: paid reseed requests and requests with bounties.
- Community Site: either Tracker can vouch, and one Site Account can link several tracker identities.
- Members keep the same Permissions on both Trackers.
- Live checks that act on an account (downloads that enter history, publications, comments, reseed requests) are a human step: the Owner designates the item and approves the call.
- Any slice that changes the UI gets an approved preview first.

## Order

Foundation, then discovery (Torznab, Cross-seed, Reseed), then detail, Catalogue and Media, then companion, Profile and RSS, then credits and Plans, then Upload and tracker updates, then community. Guides (en/fr), screenshots and the release come last.

## Fog

- Rate limits: none are documented. The frontend handles 429 with `Retry-After` (fallback 60 s), 401 as expired auth, 403 as banned, and a maintenance-coded 503. Pace requests and measure; never claim a limit nobody measured.
- Zero-seeder coverage of `/api/torznab/all` comes from the wiki and has not been measured.
- Native search returned 500 on filtered queries. The cause is unknown.
- RSS feed XML has never been fetched.
- Populated `/api/me/stats`, `/api/me/downloads` and `/api/me/sw-rewards` responses are unknown (the research account had empty ones).
- The publish response shape and the comment POST response are unverified.

## Sources

The tr4ker wiki, signed-in: [automation](https://tr4ker.net/wiki/prowlarr-radarr-sonarr), [cross-seed](https://tr4ker.net/wiki/l-outil-cross-seed), [RSS](https://tr4ker.net/wiki/flux-rss), [upload rules](https://tr4ker.net/wiki/regles-upload), [ratio](https://tr4ker.net/wiki/ratio) and [credits](https://tr4ker.net/wiki/credits). Research notes `docs/research/tr4ker-*.md` (integration, inventory, community, credits) land with the first PR.
